title: Deer Creek Falls (Legacy Minute)
place: Deer Creek Falls, Colorado River Mile 136, Grand Canyon National Park, Arizona
audio: natural (water roar + possibly ambient; mean -27 dB; nobody has listened - mute)
notes: Several shots joined by soft dissolves: 0-4 s close-up of the white water column against brown rock (water x~0.25-0.45); ~4-8 s the falls bursting out of a narrow slot in red sandstone (x~0.45-0.55, very dramatic red rock - best for square crop, centre 0.5); ~8-10 s mid shot; ~10-14 s tall water column x~0.35-0.6 with green plants. Best seconds 4-8. Source 1280x720, upscaled. The source's title text 'Deer Creek Falls / Colorado River Mile 136' and 'Minute Out In It / Grand Canyon National Park' lower-third with arrowhead appear at source 0-~5.5 s and 52-60 s - both excluded (cut starts at source 6.6 s; first frame checked clean). No people in the cut (other Deer Creek b-roll has swimmers). A cleaner but only 10 s static 1080p alternative: https://www.nps.gov/media/video/view.htm?id=46D6B336-AA98-49FB-B7F8-D238C47D12F9 ('Falls Straight On').
fact_en: NPS b-roll description: Deer Creek Falls 'emerges from a narrow defile and plummets 174ft to the pool below.'
